item.title: Contratto di ricerca: NATPRED: Naturalistic Predictions: How our brain anticipates the future in a dynamic world (Univ. TRENTO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. TRENTO, Trento
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-01 Psicologia generale, neuropsicologia e neuroscienze cognitive, psicometria

We recently developed a new approach in the lab that combines MEG recordings of participants observing naturalistic dynamic input (e.g., movies), with dynamic representational similarity analysis (dRSA) to quantify both the strength and the millisecond-precision latency of neural representations of naturalistic dynamic input, across hierarchical levels of stimulus complexity (from perceptual-to-conceptual). See [4,5] for relevant previous research from the lab. This fully-funded postdoc position is part of a larger 5-year project funded by the Italian government (FIS starting grant) on which several PhD/postdocs will work. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 research contract - Department of History and Cultures (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-27 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/HIST-01 Storia medievale

Title of the project: “Landed Wealth, Loans to Agriculturists and Exchange Rates in Genoa between the Twelfth and the Thirteenth Centuries” - The Genoese archives house the earliest collection of notarial registers of Latin Europe, which constitute an invaluable source for the economic history of the medieval Mediterranean. However, the prevailing interest in Genoese international trade has overshadowed the study of rural economy and of small-scale moneylending from citizens to rural dwellers – two research avenues that deserve further investigation.
